parsed.name: 通用USB设备
parsed.description: 通过USB连接到计算机的通用设备或实验仪器。此类设备可被主机枚举、配置，并通过控制端点及数据端点进行读写通信，适用于实验室中对各类USB接口仪器进行识别、配置和基础数据交换。
parsed.description_en: A general USB-connected device or laboratory instrument. Such a device can be enumerated and configured by a host computer and communicated with through control and data endpoints, making it suitable for identifying, configuring, and exchanging basic data with USB instruments in the lab.
